title: Jain-Friendly Crispy Mexican Sea Bass Stir-fry
description: An earthy and dense brunch-mood mexican dish featuring a jain-friendly twist on traditional seafood dishes.

ingredients.name: 1 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Gently fry the sea bass fillets in a bit of oil until golden brown on both sides. Remove from heat and keep warm.
In a pan, add vegetable oil, cumin seeds, and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add finely chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan, cook for another 2 minutes or until onions are translucent.
Add soaked and de-seeded dried chilies along with green beans. Cook for a few more minutes until chilies start to soften slightly.
Pour in the lime juice over the mixture, mix well, and let it simmer for about 5-7 minutes allowing flavors to meld together.
Place the fried sea bass fillets in the prepared dish, pour the spicy green bean sauce all over them.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes or until the fish is heated through. Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve hot and enjoy your brunch-mood mexican dish!
